questions.q: For grouped data, the mean is ____.
questions.explanation: Mean is the sum of frequency times class mark divided by total frequency.

questions.q: The empirical relation between the three measures of central tendency is ____.

questions.explanation: The middle value of five ordered numbers is the third one.

questions.q: The modal class is the class with the ____.
questions.explanation: The mode lies in the class that occurs most often.
